description: Taiwan Otsuka Pharmaceutical was founded in 1974, with the philosophy of "pursuing the health and well-being of people worldwide". With the continuous efforts for the expansion and renewal of production equipment, pharmaceutical technology has continuously improved the quality. It was approved as a GMP pharmaceutical factory by the Department of Health and the Ministry of Economic Affairs of the Executive Yuan in 1986. It was approved as a PIC/S GMP pharmaceutical factory by the Department of Health of the Executive Yuan in 2010, and its products are exported to many countries in Asia, which proves that the quality has reached the high standard. Taiwan Otsuka Pharmaceutical also adheres to the business philosophy of "Otsuka people" and is committed to research and development. We will continue to strive for perfection and make unremitting efforts for the health of the people and the well-being of the society.
